component.name: IPTVPlayer

Label.text: OK: Play | UP/DOWN: Navigate | LEFT: Channel List | BACK: Exit

component.script:
function init() m.headerLabel = m.top.findNode("headerLabel") m.statusLabel = m.top.findNode("statusLabel") m.videoPlayer = m.top.findNode("videoPlayer") m.channelList = m.top.findNode("channelList") m.controlsLabel = m.top.findNode("controlsLabel") m.channels = [] m.currentChannelIndex = 0 m.showChannels = false m.videoPlayer.observeField("state", m.port) end function
function loadChannels(channels as Object) as void m.channels = channels updateChannelList() m.statusLabel.text = "Loaded " + stri(channels.count()) + " channels. Use UP/DOWN to select or LEFT to browse." end function
function playChannel(index as Integer) as void if index >= 0 and index < m.channels.count() m.currentChannelIndex = index channel = m.channels[index] m.headerLabel.text = "IPTV Channel: " + channel.title playVideo(channel.url, channel.title) end if end function
function playVideo(url as String, title as String) as void m.videoPlayer.visible = true m.statusLabel.visible = false m.channelList.visible = false
content = createObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") content.url = url content.title = title content.streamFormat = "auto"
m.videoPlayer.content = content m.videoPlayer.control = "play" m.videoPlayer.setFocus(true) end function
function updateChannelList() as void items = [] for each channel in m.channels item = createObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") item.title = channel.title item.description = channel.url items.push(item) end for
parentNode = createObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") for each item in items parentNode.appendChild(item) end for
m.channelList.content = parentNode end function
function showError(message as String) as void m.videoPlayer.visible = false m.statusLabel.visible = true m.channelList.visible = false m.statusLabel.text = "Error: " + message end function
function onKeyEvent(key as String, press as Boolean) as Boolean if not press then return false
if key = "left" m.showChannels = not m.showChannels m.channelList.visible = m.showChannels if m.showChannels and m.channels.count() > 0 m.channelList.setFocus(true) else m.videoPlayer.setFocus(true) end if return true
else if key = "up" if m.showChannels if m.channelList.hasFocus() m.channelList.moveUp() end if else if m.currentChannelIndex > 0 playChannel(m.currentChannelIndex - 1) end if end if return true
else if key = "down" if m.showChannels if m.channelList.hasFocus() m.channelList.moveDown() end if else if m.currentChannelIndex < m.channels.count() - 1 playChannel(m.currentChannelIndex + 1) end if end if return true
else if key = "OK" if m.channelList.visible and m.channelList.hasFocus() ' Get selected item focusedChild = m.channelList.content.getChild(m.channelList.itemFocused) if focusedChild <> invalid playChannel(m.channelList.itemFocused) m.showChannels = false m.channelList.visible = false m.videoPlayer.setFocus(true) end if return true else if m.videoPlayer.visible if m.videoPlayer.paused m.videoPlayer.control = "play" else m.videoPlayer.control = "pause" end if return true end if end if
return false end function
